slides.heading: Ask the clinic if…

caption:
Physio, chiro, Pilates or massage? Mr Turtle stared at the booking page for ages. Here's the thing: there's no wrong door.

Physios and chiropractors assess and treat pain and injuries. Clinical Pilates builds strength and control through guided exercise. Remedial massage eases tight muscles and helps you feel more comfortable.

Book with anyone on our team. After an assessment, if another approach may suit you, we'll suggest it and explain why. With your consent, notes are shared so you don't repeat your story, and you always choose. If you need your GP, imaging or a specialist, we'll say so clearly.

See you at Hybrid Physio in Chatswood or Sydney CBD. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
